title: Automated uv.lock PRs: add team-review label after creation, not at creation
answers: Why do automated uv.lock PRs trigger duplicate or canceled Protect runs?
Where is the team-review label added to the bot uv.lock update PR?
Why does the uv lock update workflow sleep before labeling the PR?
Changing the uv.lock auto-update PR creation step in CI
body:
Symptom: The automated uv.lock update PR gets duplicate Protect runs, or a Protect run is canceled, when the PR is created and labeled back-to-back.
Root cause: .github/workflows/uv.yml (the step that runs gh pr create) passed --label team-review at creation, so creation and labeling events fired almost together and raced with Protect runs (protect.yml concurrency cancels one of them).
Fix pattern: Create the PR without --label, then wait (sleep 5) and run gh pr edit "$PR_URL" --add-label team-review as a separate step.
Constraints: Keep the sleep-then-label order and keep gh pr merge --auto --squash after labeling, so auto-merge survives. The five-second gap only reduces the race and does not guarantee Protect avoids cancellation if scheduling is delayed. Existing-PR update paths and protect.yml were intentionally left unchanged.
applies: Only the automated uv.lock update job in .github/workflows/uv.yml; not general PR creation elsewhere.
says: Automated dependency update pull requests trigger duplicate or canceled branch protection workflows.
Protection pipeline runs get canceled immediately after automated lockfile pull requests are opened.
Continuous integration checks on automated dependency pull requests are conflicting and canceling each other.
Prevent automated dependency pull requests from racing and canceling status verification checks.
The automated lockfile pull request triggers redundant verification builds in continuous integration.
search: In .github/workflows/uv.yml, the automated uv.lock update job must create pull requests without the team-review label and add the label in a separate step after a delay. The PR is created via gh pr create without --label, followed by sleep 5, gh pr edit with --add-label team-review, and gh pr merge --auto --squash. This separation reduces concurrency races with protect.yml that cause duplicate or canceled Protect runs, applying only to the uv.lock update job in .github/workflows/uv.yml.
